acme_dev: Hey team — customers on Windows Chrome hitting a GitHub OAuth failure when using our app deep link. They get redirected back with "error=access_denied" and our logs show "state mismatch". Happening in 2.3.1 release only. Anyone seen this?

maria_support: Thanks, can you paste the full callback URL (sanitized) and browser + OS version?

acme_dev: Callback: https://app.acme.com/auth/callback?code=abcd1234&state=Rk9PX0JBU0U2NF8rK2V4YW1wbGU%3D
Browser: Chrome 117.0.5938 on Windows 10. Also reproduces in Chrome on Win11. Works fine on macOS.

kevin_engineer: That state looks like base64url then percent-encoded. Can you check whether the deeplink (our mobile/web hybrid) is un-encoding the + char to space? Windows Chrome historically handles %2B vs + weirdly in some navigator APIs.

acme_dev: Good call — when I dump server logs the incoming state shows as: "FOO_BASE64 + example" (space instead of plus). Full raw query in our nginx access_log: /auth/callback?code=abcd1234&state=FOO_BASE64+example

jess_sre: If the client is sending %+ vs %2B, proxies or URL-decoding layers can convert + to space. Are you going through our CloudFront + corporate proxy? Any CF workers that rewrite querystrings?

acme_dev: Yes, customer route goes through an enterprise proxy that rewrites analytics params. Repro steps: 1) Click deep link app://open?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.acme.com%2Fauth%2Fcallback%3Fstate%3DFOO%2BBAR%26other%3D1 2) Chrome opens https://app.acme.com/auth/callback?state=FOO+BAR&code=... 3) Server rejects: state mismatch.

maria_support: Can you try forcing state to be base64url (replace + with - and / with _) and see if it round-trips? Also ensure we expect URL-decoded value before validating.

kevin_engineer: Quick patch: on server validation we should treat '+' as literal '+' not space when matching against original stored state. But long-term we should normalize both sides with decodeURIComponent semantics. Workaround for customer: percent-encode the + as %2B in redirect. Example curl to reproduce: 

```
curl -v "https://app.acme.com/auth/callback?code=abcd1234&state=FOO%2BBAR"
```

acme_dev: Confirmed: sending %2B makes it work. Customer can't patch proxy easily. Any suggestions for a server-side tolerance?

jess_sre: We can accept either decoded forms for short-lived states: compute both decodeURIComponent(state) and replace(/ /g,'+') and compare to stored value. I'll open a canary fix on prod with a feature flag.

maria_support: I'll notify the customer and suggest they URL-encode + as %2B as interim. Filing ticket with support: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/RED-5231 — tagging infra to watch canary. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy requested: canary/state-normalize -> staging at 2456789200, prod at 2456789600

kevin_engineer: Note for follow-up: check deep-link generation in our electron wrapper; also add docs note about using base64url or percent-encoding for state to avoid proxy rewrites.

acme_dev: Thanks everyone — customer tested the %2B workaround and confirmed login success. Closing the loop once the canary is live.
